rule: Every experiment must end in a decision: adopt opt-in code, keep existing, reject, park, or diagnostic-only. Record exact commit/run, baseline/candidate, equal-work caveat, safety, cost, next action; do not rerun identical experiments without a named new hypothesis. PASS is correctness evidence not performance promotion. No force push, no default change without authorization.
